qs.q: What is the common origin for the forearm extensor muscles associated with lateral epicondylitis, commonly known as tennis elbow?
o: Lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus
qs.e: Tennis elbow or lateral epicondylitis results from excessive or repetitive use of forearm extensor muscles at their common origin on the lateral epicondyle. The medial epicondyle is the origin for flexor muscles.
